_meta.description: Explicit Helpdesk↔Orders (and quote-engine) edges. Each edge is neither purely Helpdesk nor purely Orders configuration; both sides' evidence is referenced. Grades: STRUCTURAL (configuration read on both sides) / CONTROLLED_VERIFIED (runtime-proven).

edges.edge: Supplier action SP01 Accept -> order status Accepted -> fires Helpdesk T02
Supplier action SP02 Reject -> order status Cancelled -> fires Helpdesk T03 (job -> With Helpdesk, tag 02. Supplier rejected)
Supplier action SP03 Make appointment -> order AMO -> fires Helpdesk T04; PPM visit -> Appointment made
Supplier actions ORC10/SP04/SP06 -> order In progress -> fire Helpdesk T05
Supplier action SP05 Hold -> order On hold -> fires Helpdesk T06 (user-selects return status)
Supplier completions SP07 Work complete / Complete&Quote -> order Work complete -> fire Helpdesk RH10 / RH11 (job -> Work Complete - R)
Supplier PPM completions SP07 PPM / PPM-with-remedials / SPWA -> fire Helpdesk PH06 / PH07 (job -> PPM Complete); PPM visit -> Complete / Complete - Remedial
Supplier action BC01 Cost uplift required -> fires Helpdesk T07 (job -> Business Case - R; tag 06)
Helpdesk RH04/PH03/LM05 assign supplier -> raise order (default status Awaiting acceptance); RH04 order-status trigger field also fires ON orders->Awaiting acceptance
Helpdesk G003 Cancel job -> all non-cancelled orders -> Cancelled; PPM visits -> Aborted visit; order status Cancelled is also G003's own trigger (reverse listener)
Helpdesk G004 Close job triggers on orders->Closed; Helpdesk RH05 Approve Order fires on order approval (job Awaiting Order Approval - R -> With Contractor - R)
Job enters Awaiting Order Approval - R via the STATUS unapproved-orders flag (order raised above approval level); approval-level source unknown (UO-001)
Helpdesk Response Category Priority 1 -> Link to order priority 'Priority 1'; RH07 Amend SLA updates order priority to the helpdesk priority
Helpdesk RH04 default orders project (00001) Reactive Maintenance; PH03 -> (00002) Planned Maintenance; Stock Order type -> (00003) Stock Orders
Quote engine RE05 Raise Order -> fires Helpdesk RH03b (job Quote Requested - R -> With Contractor - R); SP07 Complete&Quote enters the quote engine from the supplier side
Helpdesk T09 AFP approved fires on application-for-payment approval; order statuses gate AFP via prevent-application flags
Order tags CU01/CU02 (Order type) and QuoteRequest tags Q1-Q4 span domains with Helpdesk tags
Order identity: order number = <parent Helpdesk job ref>/<sequence> (job 00000040 -> order 00000040/1); supplier portal exposes Parent job status/type columns and filters
